chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
If people give up something relating to religion to set right their worldly affairs, Allah will inflict upon them something more harmful than that.
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of prioritizing worldly gain over religious duties?
ai.summary: In this maxim from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) articulates a profound principle of divine reciprocity: the instrumentalization of religion for worldly benefit triggers a corresponding spiritual loss. This reflects the Shia understanding that neglecting the 'Amr' (affair/command) of faith for Dunya invites a greater, often unseen, detriment, serving as a warning against the prioritization of material stability over spiritual integrity.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 106. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
If people give up something relating to religion to set right their worldly affairs, Allah will inflict upon them something more harmful than that.
